description: This file implements an AssetCopyRepository class responsible for copying assets and related entities within a data asset management system. It includes methods for creating target assets, copying associated tables (status logs, additional IDs, properties, control device mappings, reporting attribute mappings), copying input parameters and their hierarchical and associated data (EF source mappings, throughput equations, data input values), and recording lineage metadata. The class heavily interacts with a PostgreSQL database via Npgsql, performing insertions and data copying operations, ensuring transactional integrity and logging.

classes.name: AssetCopyRepository
classes.description: Repository handling asset copying operations, including creating target assets, copying various related records, and maintaining lineage information.

methods.name: CopyAssetAsync
methods.description: Main method to copy an asset and its related data, recording lineage, within a transactional scope.

methods.name: CreateTargetAssetAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new asset record based on provided request data, returning the new asset DTO.

methods.name: CopyAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Copies status log entries from source asset to target asset.

methods.name: CopyAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Copies additional asset ID entries from source to target.

methods.name: CopyAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Copies asset properties from source to target.

methods.name: CopyControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Copies control device mappings associated with the asset.

methods.name: CopyInputParameterTreeAsync
methods.description: Copies the hierarchical input parameter tree and related mappings (EF source, throughput, data input values), returning a structured result.

methods.name: CreateLineageAsync
methods.description: Records the lineage metadata after copying an asset, including timestamp and status.
